description: This file defines a custom exception class 'BatchExecutionException' in the org.apache.fineract.batch.service package. It extends RuntimeException and encapsulates a BatchRequest object to provide contextual information when a batch execution error occurs.

classes.name: BatchExecutionException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception that includes the BatchRequest that caused the exception, providing contextual information for error handling in batch processing.

methods.name: BatchExecutionException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with the BatchRequest and the underlying RuntimeException cause.
